verdict.rationale: Ente's official CLI can automatically back up Auth codes (docs-11), and a runtime probe found it packaged in Homebrew as ente-cli, a scriptable tool for exporting Ente data and decrypting Auth exports (probe-rt-1). That gives a real but narrow headless automation path, limited to backup and export rather than general use of the product. Missing for 10: headless TOTP code generation or retrieval for CI, documented CI/non-interactive usage patterns, an automation API, and hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
